en: Zero mistakes from today so far. Sky included.
A little dust devil is riding ahead of him. It isn't even pedalling.
The last log is a decision, not an inventory item.
Moon behind a cloud, dog on the stoep. Sunday's service is over.
Ten pm fog turns every street into a film set.
The bushveld is on silent mode today. Everyone. Everything.
Sky and sea agreed on a colour this morning. Not an exciting one.
The shady side of the field is a separate climate zone.
Fireplace weather showed up without even asking.
Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.
Forgot to switch the electric blanket on in advance. Every. Single. Night.
The Friendly City never asked to be the Windy City, and yet.
The tablecloth is pressed and ready for tomorrow's service.
A few clouds came along to watch. Also not running.
Today's sky: freshly washed, ice-pressed.
The moon's on a dimmer tonight. The security light has no such setting.
No shadows, no glare, no excuses. Monday under a Tupperware lid.
Visibility: zero. Mood: surprisingly at peace with it.
One breath of rain air and suddenly the whole country is a poet.
The dog is loving this wind. He's got the only hairstyle built for it.
The sun is really milking this exit. Honestly, deserved.
Be honest — you opened this app to confirm Saturday's braai.
All plans are officially moved to 'when it clears up'. Which is never. Shame.
Sea and sky in matching grey. Only the pier lights made an effort.
Even the people who swear it never gets cold are admitting it.
The sun won't be inspecting the shine today. The car is fine with that.
Weekend grey: official permission to do absolutely nothing.
The whole veld with the colour turned down. The sheep count the same either way.
Look quickly. In ten minutes it's night and the North Pole.
The mountain's tablecloth is only half on. It's Monday, nobody's fully dressed.
The farm is still there. We're all just taking each other's word for it.
The sky is under the covers. Yours are waiting. Coincidence? Never.
The blesbok wear no scarves and file no complaints. We could learn something. We won't, but we could.
The sky is in its interview suit: grey, neat, giving nothing away.
Grey sky, jerseys on, school's out. The weekend doesn't need the sun's permission.
One cloud over the mountain is not a weather event. The fire stays lit.
Dusk is on mute tonight. The evening showed up anyway.
The sky went from light grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.
The breeze is still warm at this hour. The sea leaves the heating on all night.
The flag's giving the forecast before the surfers do. It says: go.
Last one through closes the gate. Even if nobody can see it.
The shed bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.
It's still fifty kilometres away and the stoep is already sold out.
Weather this perfect is on loan. The southeaster keeps receipts.
Walk now or don't walk at all. The Lowveld gives you until seven.
Breaking news: the puddles are open for business.
The breeze is working the fruit stall today. Air-con included, no extra charge.
The Doctor's on morning rounds. No appointment needed, unfortunately.
Early grey. Like the tea, just let it steep.
The breeze is moving the jacaranda one street over, petal by petal. The stoep approves.
You smell Highveld rain before you see it. That's the trailer.
Flags out straight, wine held tight. The deck's version of a calm Monday.
Sundowners aren't a luxury in the Lowveld. They're medical.
We're visiting outside in the cold because inside is, honestly, colder.
The dog found the exact line between sun and shade. He's staying put.
Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.
Every light on the string is swaying. Saturday night has rhythm, barely.
The sheets are dry already. Now the breeze is just showing off for the kid.
Close enough to admire, far enough that you don't have to shovel it. Perfect.
Grey day equals baking day. Somebody's kitchen already smells amazing.
The sun's clocked out. The clouds are still lit, and so is the balcony.
The clouds are passing the moon around. The balcony is happy to wait.
Breathing like a dragon, view like a dream.
The breeze is taking the smoke down the block. The whole street knows what's for supper.
Wet sea cold: the kind that gets through four layers and a good mood.
The shade is working down the rows one at a time. It's inspecting.
You can watch the cold arriving. It's not even being subtle about it.
The 5:30 runners aren't fitter than us. They're just smarter.
No wind, no clouds, no excuse for that thin jacket.
To the dam levels! Every downpour is a round on the house.
The nearest neighbours are thirty kilometres away and tonight they can see you even less.
The washing should have come in hours ago. The breeze voted to leave it.
The cattle are home before the colour goes. Sunday ends exactly on schedule.
Weather this well-behaved is definitely up to something.
Highveld winter: sunburn and frostbite achievable on the same day.
Break time, and the breeze is doing everyone's hair. Teachers included.
